items.text: Formations each holding a set point, their losses together above what the rest gives a gated condition, end it however small each one's loss. What protects what lies beyond at the set point is the choice among equal optima, which no law here models.
home_old: **Theorem** (any set of outcomes; the draw on the World, balance with the whole gaining nothing; the joint ending with activity needing support and only active giving, the gate local). *An order with a set point.* One outcome is *nearer* a set point of the family than another where at each condition of the family it lies between the set point and the other (`Regulation.Between`) and at one is strictly nearer, whatever either holds beyond; an order is *nearing* where it ranks above every nearer outcome (`Optimum.Nearing`): strictly single-peaked at the set point condition by condition, each peak not depending on the others, its sides weighed as they may be (an order costlier above than below is one, `Skew.nearing`). Where the family holds a condition, no asymmetric nearing order is rising (`Optimum.Nearing.not_rising`). Below the set point it rises: among outcomes up to the set point its optima stand at the least level beyond exactly where room holds there (`Optimum.least_below_iff`), and among the outcomes open to a part every optimum standing below its set point takes the part's whole capacity beyond, where every rising optimum stands (`Optimum.nearing_beyond`, `Optimum.nearing_as_rising`, from `Optimum.beyond_of_ranked`). Where an eligible outcome reaches the set point every optimum stands at it, whatever the room (`Optimum.atSetPoint_of_reach`), and an outcome is an optimum of some nearing order exactly where it is eligible and at the set point (`Optimum.optima_iff`, near-definitional): the class asks nothing of what lies beyond. In a balanced step in which the whole gains nothing, the beyond then falls by the family's shortfall from its set point with what the step loses (`Flow.Balances.atSetPoint_draws`); with one condition beyond, its dependence breaks exactly where that exceeds its slack (`Flow.Balances.atSetPoint_broken_iff`), and with several some dependence breaks where it exceeds their total slack (`Flow.Balances.atSetPoint_breaks`). Several nearing optimizers draw their joint shortfall, as one with their joint set point, and break a dependence beyond where it exceeds the slack, whatever each one's own (`Flow.Balances.mutual_atSetPoint_breaks`). A formation alone with its family, holding the family's stock, takes at least its loss from a condition (`Flow.held_draws`), so formations so holding, their losses together above what the rest gives a  gated condition, end it however small each one's loss (`Flow.held_excess_ends`, from `Flow.joint_excess_ends`); no order or choice enters that law.

items.text: Never leaving: for every process and guard, no course leaves the guard exactly when some certificate contains it (pure core). Market instance on periphery: no entry from unsafe states, no compliance by actual markets.

items.text: Theorem (any process; periphery, axioms reported). Reciprocal eventual promises hold on both sides where neither ever happens; in the exchange witness an empty or one-sided start never becomes jointly active, and ignition needs a reserve already present. How a supported start forms is not shown.
home_old: **Theorem** (any process; periphery module [`SeededContinuation`](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/systems-complexity/analysis/SeededContinuation.lean), `propext` in some of the cited declarations and none in the others, as its receipt reports; `Quot.sound` enters only `absent_reserve_blocks_ignition`). With faithful joint-to-local projections and valid local plans, two properties of the joint configuration holding on the covered start, every pair of locally authorized moves jointly allowed with a successor wherever both hold, and every admitted joint successor keeping both, the paired finite plan is valid (`seeded_joint_plan`). Promises do not: "if the other eventually does, I eventually do" holds on both sides where neither ever happens (`reciprocal_eventual_promises_can_be_empty`), and a law with no successors keeps every property vacuously (`preservation_without_availability`). In the exchange witness an empty or one-sided start never becomes jointly active, and ignition needs a reserve already present (`ignition_requires_actual_reserve`): one circular dependence can be maintenance running or a wait no one can begin.
